in_sanskrit.name: सोहनलाल
in_sanskrit.meaning: सोहन (Sohan) - Delight, Joy, Bliss, Beauty लाल (Lal) - Red, Crimson, Rosy
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who brings delight and joy, and whose complexion is red or rosy.

in_hindi.name: सोहनलाल
in_hindi.meaning: सोहन (Sohan) - आनन्द (Anand) - Joy, Happiness, Delight लाल (Lal) - लाल (Laal) - Red, Crimson, Rosy
in_hindi.long_meaning: The one who brings joy, happiness, and delight, and whose complexion is red or rosy.

in_marathi.name: Sohanlal
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Divine, Radiant, Shining God
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sohanlal हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Sohan means divine, radiant, shining, and Lal means God, which makes Sohanlal a powerful name for a boy, symbolizing strength, victory, and the divine presence of God.
